notes: Fixed a real case where a genuinely non-European manufacturer (confirmed Indonesian) still made it into a Europe-only report even after the new verification search correctly found its real country - the country list the tool checks against was missing Indonesia and about 25 other common manufacturing countries (Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Saudi Arabia, and more), so a correct search result had nowhere to be matched against. All of those are now recognized, closing this gap. Reminder: if a run still looks thin or off for a market, first check that your DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in .env is a valid, working key.
